ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across >90% of surface area, with sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on lateral tips and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-pigmented lobes. High-contrast white geometric clusters (barnacles) mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips. Sparse white linear and circular clusters distributed across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal convergence angle of approximately 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from 5-15px. Distal tips exhibit extreme jaggedness due to barnacle protrusion, while medial sections show smoother, lower-amplitude waves.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the notch transitioning to a steep upward-flaring concave arc at the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary high-contrast clusters at the distal tips (barnacle colonies). One distinct circular white ring-shaped scar located in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense concentration of unaligned, high-contrast white linear scratches on the left lobe, showing a high density of criss-crossing paths in the lower-medial area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both lateral tips resulting in irregular, high-contrast edge topography. Multiple rake-like linear scars present on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent white ring-shaped lesion or scar on the interior right lobe surface, distinct from linear abrasions.
